scores.evidence: J-1: Structured Deficiency Tagging ([P-02]) — covers [F-001 / FR-01], [AC-001], [AC-002] ... J-2: One-click local punch-list report export ... — covers [F-002 / FR-02], [AC-003], [AC-004]

S-01 Dashboard – Loading, Empty, Populated, Error, No Permission defined; S-02 Deficiency Tagging Workspace – Loading, Empty, Populated, Error, No Permission defined; S-03 Punch List Export – Loading, Empty, Populated, Error, No Permission defined.

Screens table Auth / Role column lists `[P-01], [P-02]` for S-01, `[P-02]` for S-02, `[P-01]` for S-03; journeys explicitly reference personas e.g., "Structured Deficiency Tagging ([P-02])" and "One-click local punch-list report export ([P-01])".

Navigation section describes Top Bar, Sidebar, Footer and states: "2-Click Rule: All primary operational workflows and screens are directly accessible within 2 clicks from the Dashboard (home) screen."
Screens table Technical Contracts column cites `[API-001]`, `[TBL-01]` for S-01 and S-02, `[API-002]`, `[TBL-02]` for S-03; journeys reference the same API and table IDs when describing actions.

“Every foreground text and interactive token passes WCAG 2.2 AA minimum contrast (>= 4.5:1 for normal text, >= 3:1 for large text/components).” Also token rows list concrete ratios, e.g., “`--color-primary` … L: 5.91:1 (PASS) / D: 5.23:1 (PASS)”. Later the UX Principles state “Full Keyboard Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA): All interactive controls are navigable via keyboard with visible focus rings and logical tab order (`[NFR-05]`).”

Design token table provides concrete hex values for both Light and Dark themes with contrast ratios, e.g., “| `--color-primary` | `#A04000` | `#db6f28` | … L: 5.91:1 (PASS) / D: 5.23:1 (PASS) |”. Component specifications table lists each component with default style, interaction states (hover, focus, disabled, loading) and notes, e.g., “`Button (Primary)` … **Hover**: 10% dark overlay. **Focus**: 2px ring. **Disabled**: opacity 0.5. **Loading**: spinner icon.” No “TBD” placeholders are present.

Breakpoints table defines three standard ranges and corresponding layout adaptations: “| `Mobile (< 640 px)` | < 640px | Sidebar collapses into off‑canvas mobile drawer; data tables switch to stacked card view; touch targets expand to minimum 44px. |”, “| `Tablet (640–1024 px)` | 640px–1024px | Sidebar collapses to icon rail (64px width); top bar search collapses to icon trigger; 2‑column dashboard grid. |”, “| `Desktop (> 1024 px)` | > 1024px | Full 240px persistent sidebar; expanded global search; 3‑column dashboard metric layout; full multi‑column data tables. |”.

verdict_summary: Design PASSED Judge audit with score 24/24.
